description: A field derived from its siblings (`span = b - a`) under `invariant (span <= 10)`: the sibling write `@w.b = 20` is checked with span recomputed on the candidate and traps (E-WRITE-INVARIANT-RT) before the write — span stays 5 and the handler's next statement never runs.
rationale: Ruling S483-invariant-derived-split: "check-at-source is built for a field derived only from the value's own sibling fields (a sibling write re-checks the candidate)".
